motion.name: button-background
motion.purpose: Existing button hover transition; removed for prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Existing diagnostic action, including hover, focus, disabled, and reduced-motion behavior.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { font: 600 14px/1.6 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 18px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease-out; background: var(--blue, #0066cc); color: white; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--blue-hover, #0055aa); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0071e3); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Existing diagnostic action, including hover, focus, disabled, and reduced-motion behavior.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { font: 600 14px/1.6 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 18px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease-out; background: var(--soft, #e9e9ee); color: var(--text, #202124); } .ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--line, #dcdce0); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0071e3); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: State badge
components.description: Noninteractive textual session or experiment state.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font: 600 12px/1.6 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #62636a); background: var(--soft, #e9e9ee); border-radius: 20px; padding: 5px 11px; text-align: center; }

components.name: Diagnostic workspace
components.description: Flat tonal container for the read-only check.
components.html:
Check your AirPods

Use current Microsoft Edge on Windows 11.
components.css: .ds-workspace { background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #202124); border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-workspace-title { font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -.025em; margin: 0; font-weight: 650; } .ds-workspace-copy { color: var(--muted, #62636a); font-size: 14px; margin: 12px 0 20px; max-width: 72ch; } @media (max-width: 580px) { .ds-workspace { padding: 24px 20px; } }

components.name: Broadcast permission checkbox
components.description: Native optional permission control with associated label and hint.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; font: 14px/1.6 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--text, #202124); cursor: pointer; margin: 24px 0; } .ds-checkbox { accent-color: var(--blue, #0066cc); width: 18px; height: 18px; margin: 3px 0 0; flex: 0 0 18px; } .ds-checkbox:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0071e3); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-choice-hint { display: block; color: var(--muted, #62636a); font-size: 13px; margin-top: 3px; }

narrative.overview: This records the implemented diagnostic, using its existing label as the organizing description. The confirmed direction is restrained Apple-inspired materials and system typography: a quiet page, a tonal workspace, clear actions, and explicit evidence. No new visual identity or full manager design is established here.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal surfaces with generous outer space and compact diagnostic rows.
System light/dark appearance and a single blue action accent.
Native controls, visible focus, plain-language status, and honest unavailable states.
dos: Do preserve system fonts, system color preference, reduced-motion behavior, and visible keyboard focus.
Do distinguish API availability, selection, GATT connection, one-time readings, and verified device capabilities in text.
Do allow device text and controls to wrap on narrow screens.
donts: Don't represent mocked screenshots or a connected badge as evidence of AirPods hardware support.
Don't add fabricated live readings or controls to imply a functional manager.
Don't require new imagery, downloaded fonts, installations, or experimental browser flags for this diagnostic.
